evidence.detail: rs/d/g derives one fixed source path from the client cache root: configs/old_i.dat.

Its parser recognizes exact [item ...] block headers and item-definition keys including name, modelid/groundmodel, clone, description, zoom, offsets, value, textures, actions, equipment fields, stack ids/amounts, cert/note/template and stackable.
Parsed blocks create or clone R28 ItemDefinition instances, mutate their ItemDefinition fields directly, and are returned in an item-id keyed Trove object map.
The class preserves the exact mismatch diagnostic 'Error! Detected mismatch at line: <n>' and exposes a companion path that reads the same old_i.dat source into a raw line list.

proposals.note: LegacyItemDefinitionConfigParser is the conservative semantic name for this exact old_i.dat item-definition parser. No direct exact-v308 caller survives, so confidence is deliberately lower than runtime-wired batches and the name does not imply active production use or a verbatim original identifier.
